# Phys.org
> Daily science news covering research developments, technological breakthroughs, and scientific discoveries across major disciplines.

Phys.org is a science news publication in the Science X network. It organizes current research reporting by subject area, offers chronological and weekly news feeds, and links readers to related network sites for medicine and technology coverage.

## Core News Feeds
- [Homepage](https://phys.org/): Main landing page for current science headlines and featured research stories.
- [Latest News](https://phys.org/latest-news/): Reverse-chronological feed of newly published science news articles.
- [Week's Top](https://phys.org/weekly-news/): Most-read and highlighted science stories from the past week.
- [Unread News](https://phys.org/unread-news/): Personalized feed of unread articles for returning readers.
- [All News by Date](https://phys.org/sort/date/all): Site-wide archive of articles sorted chronologically.
- [Editorials](https://phys.org/editorials/): In-depth features, analysis, and longer-form science reporting.

## Physics & Nanotechnology
- [Physics News](https://phys.org/physics-news/): Physics coverage spanning condensed matter, optics, quantum, and particle research.
- [Nanotechnology News](https://phys.org/nanotech-news/): News on nanoscale materials, devices, fabrication, and applications.
- [General Physics](https://phys.org/physics-news/physics/): General physics reporting on theory, experiments, and instrumentation.
- [Quantum Physics](https://phys.org/physics-news/quantum-physics/): Research news on quantum systems, information, and phenomena.
- [Condensed Matter](https://phys.org/physics-news/condensed-matter/): Coverage of materials physics, electronic structure, and emergent properties.
- [Optics & Photonics](https://phys.org/physics-news/optics-photonics/): Articles on lasers, light-matter interaction, and photonic technologies.

## Space, Astronomy & Planetary Science
- [Astronomy & Space News](https://phys.org/space-news/): News on astronomy, astrophysics, planetary science, and space missions.
- [Astronomy](https://phys.org/space-news/astronomy/): Reporting on stars, galaxies, cosmology, and observational discoveries.
- [Planetary Sciences](https://phys.org/space-news/planetary-sciences/): Coverage of planets, moons, atmospheres, and Solar System research.
- [Space Exploration](https://phys.org/space-news/space-exploration/): Mission updates, spacecraft technology, and human spaceflight news.
- [Astrobiology](https://phys.org/space-news/astrobiology/): Research on habitability, biosignatures, and life beyond Earth.

## Earth & Environment
- [Earth News](https://phys.org/earth-news/): Earth science coverage including climate, geology, oceans, and ecosystems.
- [Environment](https://phys.org/earth-news/environment/): News on biodiversity, conservation, pollution, and environmental change.
- [Earth Sciences](https://phys.org/earth-news/earth-sciences/): Reporting on geology, geophysics, volcanology, and tectonics.
- [Climate Change](https://phys.org/earth-news/climate-change/): Research and analysis on climate systems, impacts, and mitigation.
- [Ecology](https://phys.org/earth-news/ecology/): Articles on ecosystems, species interactions, and ecological processes.

## Chemistry & Materials
- [Chemistry News](https://phys.org/chemistry-news/): Chemistry reporting on synthesis, analysis, reactions, and molecular science.
- [Analytical Chemistry](https://phys.org/chemistry-news/analytical-chemistry/): News on measurement methods, instrumentation, and chemical detection.
- [Biochemistry](https://phys.org/chemistry-news/biochemistry/): Coverage of chemical processes in living systems and biomolecules.
- [Materials Science](https://phys.org/chemistry-news/materials-science/): Research on functional materials, interfaces, and advanced compounds.
- [Organic Chemistry](https://phys.org/chemistry-news/organic-chemistry/): Articles on carbon-based molecules, synthesis, and reactivity.

## Biology & Life Sciences
- [Biology News](https://phys.org/biology-news/): Life science news covering genetics, evolution, microbiology, and physiology.
- [Molecular & Computational Biology](https://phys.org/biology-news/molecular-computational-biology/): Research on molecular mechanisms, modeling, and bioinformatics.
- [Cell & Microbiology](https://phys.org/biology-news/cell-microbiology/): Coverage of cells, microbes, infection, and host-pathogen interactions.
- [Genetics](https://phys.org/biology-news/genetics/): News on genomes, inheritance, gene regulation, and biotechnology.
- [Plants & Animals](https://phys.org/biology-news/plants-animals/): Reporting on botany, zoology, behavior, and biodiversity.
- [Biotechnology](https://phys.org/biology-news/biotechnology/): Articles on applied biology, engineering, and translational research.

## Other Sciences
- [Other Sciences News](https://phys.org/science-news/): Multidisciplinary coverage beyond core physical and life sciences.
- [Archaeology & Fossils](https://phys.org/science-news/archaeology-fossils/): News on ancient cultures, paleontology, and historical discoveries.
- [Social Sciences](https://phys.org/science-news/social-sciences/): Research on behavior, society, economics, and policy.
- [Business](https://phys.org/science-news/business/): Science-related business, industry, and innovation reporting.
- [Education](https://phys.org/science-news/education/): Articles on science education, learning, and academic practice.

## Discovery Topics & Reference
- [Topics](https://phys.org/tags/): Browse subject tags used across Phys.org articles.
- [Top Stories](https://phys.org/sort/popular/1w/): Popular science stories ranked by recent reader interest.
- [Last 24 Hours](https://phys.org/sort/date/24h/): Science news published during the previous day.
- [Last 7 Days](https://phys.org/sort/date/7d/): Recent science reporting from the past week.
- [Last 30 Days](https://phys.org/sort/date/30d/): Monthly archive of recently published articles.

## Accounts & Reader Services
- [Account Help](https://sciencex.com/help/account/): Help resources for Science X account access and settings.
- [Register](https://sciencex.com/profile/register/): Create a Science X account for personalized reading features.
- [Password Reset](https://sciencex.com/profile/pwdreset/): Reset credentials for an existing Science X account.

## Science X Network
- [Medical Xpress](https://medicalxpress.com/): Sister site focused on medicine, health, and biomedical research news.
- [Tech Xplore](https://techxplore.com/): Sister site covering engineering, electronics, AI, and technology news.
- [Science X](https://sciencex.com/): Network hub for account services and related science publishing properties.
